summary: Regression testing after code-review fixes. Backend: all 19 pytest tests PASS. Frontend: cookie-based auth confirmed (no localStorage), all admin tabs load, session persists on refresh, contact form works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth hardening verified: access_token cookie is httpOnly=true, secure=true, samesite=lax — matches expected playbook.
localStorage.cs_admin_token confirmed undefined both before and after login — client correctly relies on httpOnly cookie only.
CORS allow_credentials=true with explicit origins from env — frontend and backend on same preview domain, so cookies flow seamlessly.
Seed/admin credential loading from .env via dotenv confirmed working (tests read ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD at runtime).
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from all public endpoints (/api/site, /api/projects, /api/experience).
Projects.jsx ProjectCard extraction works — 12 cards render correctly with stable composite keys, modal opens with detail.
No console errors on public site or any admin tab.
seed_data_creation: Created then cleaned up 1 TEST_E2E contact message; also cleaned up an orphaned TEST_UI_User message from previous iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All regression checks passed. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 19 tests). Credentials loaded via dotenv from backend/.env. Cookie auth (httpOnly + secure + samesite=lax) is the only auth mechanism on frontend. Frontend testids: admin-login-page, admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, contact-name, contact-email, contact-phone, contact-message, contact-submit, project-card-<id>, project-modal.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in this regression run.
